evidence_seen_before_freeze: analytical unit tests and one/four-update engineering controls only; no 48 h trajectory, profile, or cumulative-uptake result
claim_boundary: engineering preregistration pending independent numerical review; not release evidence

solver_guard.reason: default MLMG tolerance violated the pre-existing P10 integrated ledger during the first one-step engineering attempt

acceptance_gates.positivity: no mesh or internal D amount below the frozen P10 negative-amount tolerance
acceptance_gates.conservation: every P10 O01/O10/checkpoint residual is within max(1e-28 mol,1e-10*S_L1)
acceptance_gates.cumulative_uptake: successive-level final cumulative accepted uptake relative difference <= 0.02
acceptance_gates.profile: successive-level volume-weighted mesh-D profile L1 relative difference <= 0.05 at every observation
acceptance_gates.restart: same-rank continuous/restart cumulative ledgers exact and state fields within the existing P10-U04 comparator
acceptance_gates.selection: use the coarsest level for which it and every finer successor satisfy all gates

replicate_policy: canonical deterministic run plus one clean-environment deterministic rerun; byte-identical inputs and hashes required

technical_gate_disposition.gap: exact graph-distance origin, partial-segment area rule, branch tie handling, and initial area-match normalization are not specified by the adopted source
technical_gate_disposition.rationale: The fixed network contains exactly one 0.003 cm live-tip segment, wholly inside the smallest 0.005 cm zone. All tip cases therefore use its complete stored surface and the area-matched multiplier is exactly one. Runtime aborts if any non-tip, longer segment, or topology would require an unstated graph-distance, branch-tie, partial-area, or normalization rule.
